items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
items.claim: The text says the rules that follow were given by the LORD to Moses and Aaron.

items.quote: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
items.claim: A person with a rising, scab, or bright spot on the skin that looks like leprosy must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons.
items.object: Aaron the priest or one of his sons the priests
items.mechanism: priests have authority over skin disease

items.quote: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh:
items.claim: The priest must examine the affected skin.
items.object: the plague in the skin of the flesh

items.quote: when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy:
items.claim: The text gives two signs that a mark is leprosy: the hair in it has turned white, and it looks deeper than the skin.
items.mechanism: signs that can be seen (white hair, looks deeper than the skin)

items.quote: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
items.claim: If the signs are there, the priest must declare the person unclean.
